title: Person Timeline World Implementation Layer v1.0
description: Implementation layer around the frozen PERSON_SCHEMA_V1.0. Membership and topic links are separate from the canonical person schema. Roster entries (core_roster_1000.json) are a separate, non-conformant record track from canonical PERSON_SCHEMA_V1.0 person records; see personRegistry.

personRegistry.description: Documents the split between rosterEntries (provisional, hint-field roster, NOT schema-conformant) and canonicalPersonRecords (must conform to PERSON_SCHEMA_V1.0, currently unpopulated rather than guess-filled).
